cards.name: hero
cards.question: Tier List Maker
cards.answer: Rank Text & Images, Save as an Image
cards.qualifier: Make a tier list in your browser: add text or images, drag them into tiers, rename and recolor the tiers, then save the result as an image for your next ranking post.

cards.name: make-a-tier-list
cards.title: Make a tier list in your browser

groups.label: Add text and images
groups.text: Type an item into Add text and press Enter (or tap +).

groups.label: Drag or tap to rank
groups.text: Drag an item with your finger or mouse and drop it into any tier.

groups.label: Rename and recolor tiers
groups.text: Tap any tier label to rename it, up to 24 characters.

groups.label: The classic S to D template
groups.text: The default five tiers are the format most people recognize instantly.

groups.label: Custom tiers that fit the topic
Topics that start conversations
groups.text: Pick a topic your audience has opinions about and a list of 10 to 25 items.

cards.name: making-tier-list-content
cards.title: Making tier list content for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube

groups.label: Tier list videos
groups.text: The most popular tier list videos show the ranking happening.

groups.label: Instagram carousels
groups.text: For a reveal carousel, press Save as image after you fill each tier.

groups.label: TikTok photo posts and YouTube
groups.text: TikTok photo posts look best at full-screen 9:16.

cards.name: key-point
cards.quote: A tier list ranks things in groups instead of one long numbered list.
